classification: TASGNSS is a later refactor, not the original Hu paper-era implementation.

missing_fixed_arrays: current TASGNSS broadcast-ionosphere delay per retained row
current TASGNSS Saastamoinen-troposphere delay per retained row
compatibility_gate.reason: The frozen NPZ contains corrected pseudorange, satellite position/clock, elevation, support, and the seven-state OLS solution, but not the atmospheric arrays TASGNSS freezes at a separate RTKLIB pntpos receiver position. Recomputing them would be new preprocessing, not an exact same input.

current_tasgnss.state: ECEF x/y/z plus G,C,E,R,J,I,SBAS receiver clocks in metres
current_tasgnss.sagnac: computed once using the RTKLIB pntpos approximate receiver position
current_tasgnss.ionosphere: broadcast IONOOPT_BRDC, computed once using populated geodist LOS
current_tasgnss.troposphere: Saastamoinen TROPOPT_SAAS, computed once using populated geodist LOS
current_tasgnss.code_bias: prange applies DCB and constellation TGD/BGD corrections
current_tasgnss.elevation_azimuth: geodist populates LOS before satazel for atmosphere; a separate ECEF-to-ENU calculation provides stored az/el
current_tasgnss.measurement_exclusion: fewer than four raw rows, absent ephemeris, zero corrected pseudorange, or too few observations for active constellation count
current_tasgnss.convergence: norm(dp) <= 0.001 m; reaching maxiter is failure
current_tasgnss.weight_semantics: custom w forms W=diag(w), so effective precision is w^2; constant positive uniform scaling is solution-invariant
current_tasgnss.initial_state: public wls_pnt_pos starts ECEF position and all receiver clocks at zero

historical_paper_runtime.paper_ols_atmosphere: recomputed every iteration from geodist-populated LOS
historical_paper_runtime.neutral_torch_atmosphere: recomputed calls receive unpopulated LOS and yield the established zero-delay path
historical_paper_runtime.state: ECEF x/y/z plus G,C,E,R receiver clocks in metres; inactive columns removed

selected_current_backend.selector: origin (rtklib environment variable is not demo5)
selected_current_backend.build_policy: built from a disposable source copy outside the read-only reference repository
